scenarios.title: Complete supplied lesson inputs: prepare now, review before JSON
given: Course DEMO 101, Invented Route Workshop; scope labels, tags and route order; term unknown. No formal objectives were supplied.
Readable passage A: A route is an ordered list of stops. A label names one stop. Changing a label does not change route order. Rearranging stops changes the order.
Readable passage B: A tag groups stops by a shared feature. Two stops may share a tag while retaining different labels.
These are the entire selected passages for this small invented lesson; their availability does not establish coverage of any larger course.
scenarios.expectedFirstReply: You want to review labels, tags and route order in DEMO 101. I can read both pasted passages; no formal objectives were supplied. I’ll use those passages to make the study guide, clearly labeled study objectives and supported practice now.
expectedNext: Continue immediately with supported teaching and original self-contained practice; do not wait for a go-ahead after the opening.
Keep the lecture-style guide and mastery lenses distinct. If these brief passages cannot justify an ordinary depth floor, explain the precise evidence limit rather than padding.
Preserve term=null and derive only supported study objectives; do not block on optional metadata.
Keep the complete actual draft accessible alongside the content-specific companion message; no claim the student read it or that the summary validates accuracy.
scenarios.expectedAfterReply: Present the actual readable guide and mastery/practice content, with source limits and a concise review, then ask whether the student wants changes or wants this content turned into JSON. Stop without an importable JSON file or code block; no post-review confirmation has been given.
scenarios.necessaryPause: Wait for explicit confirmation of this actual readable draft before final JSON. No routine approval is needed to prepare it.
mustPreserve: All facts and qualifications from both supplied passages.
Explicit source versus generated-objective/practice status.
No final importable JSON before explicit confirmation of the current actual readable draft.
scenarios.companionReviewMessage:
- Labels name individual stops; tags group stops by a shared feature.
- Route order changes when stops move; renaming a stop alone leaves the order unchanged.
- The draft uses supported recall and applications of these distinctions; no formal course objectives or larger-course coverage are claimed.

Want more examples of labels versus tags, more practice distinguishing renaming from reordering, or anything explained differently? If you’re happy with this version, say “Create the JSON.”
